prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Houston, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1084; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a two-lane road in Houston, Texas, near an intersection with a gas station on the corner.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was driving straight, maybe at about twenty-five miles an hour. The other car came over into my lane.

Q: Did you try to avoid the collision?
A: I braked and turned a little to the right, but there wasn't enough room. It was a head-on hit, though not a hard one.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. I was pushed forward and then back against the seat.

Q: Did you get checked out by anyone after the accident?
A: I drove myself to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon because my neck was stiff and sore.

Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: The main issue is my neck. It aches when I turn my head, and I have a headache that comes and goes. My shoulders feel tight too.

Q: Are you still receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: I missed a couple of days, and I've been limiting how long I sit at my desk.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this accident?
A: I had some occasional stiffness in the past, but nothing that stopped me from working or exercising.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled fairly. Thank you.
